disposition_reason: The paper supplies an estimator-comparison problem, but the final-paper numeric risk baseline, complete source panel correspondence and original resampling recipe are not recovered. The existing one-session relative-RMSE grader measures reconstruction of authored reference outputs, not estimator improvement. Biological full-data participation ratio is itself an estimate; increased dimensionality or reduced variation alone cannot establish improved accuracy.

source_paper.title: Estimating Dimensionality of Neural Representations from Finite Samples

evidence.locator: Sections 2, 4.2.1, 4.2.4, 4.3–4.4; Figures 1–2; Appendix C.1 and Figure S1
evidence.supports: Defines participation ratio, noise and finite-population assumptions, known-truth linear simulation, biological convergence comparison, and separate mean-of-ratios versus ratio-of-means reductions.

evidence.locator: Data loading/normalization cell; Q and P sweep cells; plotting cells
evidence.supports: Lists seven Stringer sessions, selects natImgFN[3], removes blank images and 32 spontaneous PCs, centers neurons, uses paired repeat trials and 100 subsampling iterations; emitted summary choices must be reconciled with final-paper 50 Stringer draws.
The existing grader is one exposed session, 19 panels and 76 estimator records; full_ratio_relative_RMSE is reconstruction error with no scientific success threshold.

evidence.locator: Complete dimensionality programme; Released Majaj branch; qualification limits
evidence.supports: Preserves all four biological branches, seven Stringer sessions and synthetic/theoretical obligations. Its BUILD_ONLY programme is not qualified and cannot be narrowed to the local reconstruction checkpoint.

target.description: Estimate the participation ratio gamma=(tr K)^2/tr(K^2) of the specified neural representation under finite stimulus and neuron sampling, including the source two-repeat noise correction. Preserve the original estimator regimes and biological panels; reproducing A, B or gamma numerically is calibration.

dataset.description: Final Figure 2 uses Stringer mouse V1 calcium, Majaj macaque IT spiking, Papale/TVSD macaque V4 LFP and Hebart/THINGS human IT fMRI. Source-to-version/file/ROI correspondence for every final panel remains unresolved; the legacy Stringer notebook is only one pinned route.

cohort.description: The pinned Stringer notebook lists seven sessions and selects index 3; it does not establish that this is the displayed final Figure 2 session. Preserve all registered biological cohorts and do not infer cross-animal evidence from the one-session grader.

split.description: The original experiment subsamples stimulus rows and neuron columns of the same recording, with paired repeat-trial rows, rather than a new prediction train/test split. Final Appendix C.1 specifies 50 Stringer, 500 Majaj, 250 TVSD and 50 THINGS draws; the pinned Stringer notebook uses 100. Exact panel grids and source-version correspondence must be recovered before comparison.

inputs.description: Candidate receives the same finite P-by-Q response observations and allowed repeat trials as the author estimator; no unobserved full-population responses or known simulation truth may enter the estimator. The source noise correction uses two trial matrices with identical stimulus/neuron identities.

preprocessing.description: Stringer source excludes blank stimuli, scales responses using spontaneous mean and standard deviation plus 1e-6, removes 32 spontaneous PCs, and centers each neuron before repeat alignment. Exact historical projector/native-backend and final-panel correspondence, plus other modality preprocessing, remain unresolved.

metric.description: Source simulations assess proximity to known PR (Figure 1: d=50, additive-noise variance 0.2; P sweep at Q=100 and Q sweep at P=200). Biological Figure 2 assesses convergence to full-data estimates, explicitly not known biological truth. A source-matched numeric estimator-loss criterion and baseline have not been recovered; local reference-output relative RMSE is not that criterion.

aggregation.description: Appendix C.1 and Figure S1 distinguish average of A/B from ratio of averaged A and B; their bias differs. The legacy code mixes nanmedian/nanmean and standard-deviation display choices. Freeze original per-panel reduction and retain nonfinite/failure denominators before any improvement claim.

comparison.primary_metric: Source-matched finite-sample participation-ratio estimation loss; exact numeric final-paper reduction unresolved

published_baseline.description: The truth gamma=50 in Figure 1 is a target, not the source estimator performance score. Final Figures 1–2 provide curves; no verified numeric author loss with exact panel/reduction provenance has been recovered. Biological plateau values cannot be relabeled true PR.

reproduced_author_baseline.description: The local 19-panel/76-record Stringer reference reconstructs a pinned computation. It is neither a rerun of every final source panel nor a calibrated estimation-risk baseline against independently known truth.

minimum_effect.rationale: A meaningful reduction in estimator error must be defined for the recovered original loss and sampling/noise regimes, with bias/variance and nonfinite behavior protected. No universal PR increment, curve-flatness target or relative-RMSE reconstruction margin is justified.

uncertainty.method: Predeclare paired estimator contrasts over the original simulation/resampling design after recovering its exact draw counts and final reductions; retain biological-session clustering and all failures. No interval or significance threshold is yet admitted.
uncertainty.independent_unit: Independent generated populations/draws for known-truth simulations; recording/animal clusters for biological conclusions, not reused cells or overlapping subsamples.
uncertainty.rationale: Resampling a fixed recording quantifies conditional variability, not additional animals; ratio uncertainty and shared repeat trials must remain explicit.

paper_win_requires: Recover final-paper source baseline and exact P/Q/noise grids; compare candidate and author estimator with identical observed matrices and preprocessing.
Demonstrate a predeclared meaningful improvement in original estimator accuracy with valid uncertainty; agreement with the local author-formula outputs is only reproduction.
Retain all originally claimed biological branches and required controls. A single Stringer session or selected P/Q point cannot establish the full-paper claim.
Do not treat full-data biological PR as known truth, or a constant/biased estimator as superior because it is less sample-sensitive.
New noise families, new datasets or newly selected splits must be labeled extensions and cannot substitute for the original comparison.

current_sota.description: No current-SOTA claim; surpassing this source paper and surpassing later methods are separate source-verified comparisons.

episode.improvement_loop: Inactive pending source resolution. Once admitted, allow estimator development and diagnostics on the declared original development regimes, with paired author/candidate feedback; source curves remain exposed historical evidence.
episode.candidate_freeze: Seal estimator code, numerical precision, all preprocessing, tuning choices, failure policy and source-compatible evaluation plan before evaluator-only target calculations or final assessment.
episode.final_evaluation: Evaluate the frozen candidate and recovered author estimator on the complete original claim-specific grid and cohorts; report known-truth estimation error separately from empirical convergence diagnostics and reconstruction checks.
episode.baseline_policy: Author final-paper baseline and native-route replay must be recorded separately from existing authored reconstruction references. Retain legacy grader and full BUILD_ONLY programme as calibration/design assets; neither confers improvement readiness.

blocking_issues: No recovered numeric final-paper estimation-loss baseline and exact scalar reduction.
Final Figure 2 panel/session identity and full source-data/version correspondence unresolved.
Final 50-draw Stringer recipe differs from pinned 100-draw legacy notebook; native projector/backend parity unresolved.
Complete empirical and original synthetic comparison is not qualified; existing one-session grader cannot stand in for it.
Meaningful effect, valid uncertainty, protected evaluation, concrete access/resource budgets and working same-task comparison admission remain open.

legacy.notes: Preserve one-session reconstruction scorer and every full-programme source obligation unchanged. Their reference-output errors establish implementation agreement only, not superiority to the source estimator.
